views.title: Parliament from Bundesplatz
views.description: Oblique exterior inspection; roof and opening detail remains an interpreted reconstruction.

views.title: Principal floor
views.description: Inspect the modeled divisions and openings. A mesh slice, not a surveyed plan.

views.title: Interior cutaway
views.description: Inspect modeled chambers and hall. Some surrounding surfaces remain simplified.

views.title: Bern and the surrounding buildings
views.description: Schematic surroundings around the interpreted Parliament building; source georeferencing is retained.

views.title: North entrance foyer
views.description: Reference-led v014 refinement. Camera and dimensions fitted to retained building; fine carving remains simplified.

views.description: Reference-led v014 refinement. Camera and dimensions fitted to retained building; fine carving remains simplified.

pointsOfInterest.title: National Council
pointsOfInterest.description: Two hundred modeled main member positions; dimensions and ornament remain interpreted.

pointsOfInterest.title: Council of States
pointsOfInterest.description: Forty-six modeled main member positions; mural and upper gallery geometry remain provisional.

pointsOfInterest.title: South public entrance and lobby
pointsOfInterest.description: Tiefparterre below the National Council; photo-supported reconstruction. Door units are static; walking through them is not enabled.
